proposals.principle: Choose transparent vocabulary using verified independent language-family evidence, not European cognate frequency.
proposals.hypothesis: Cross-family attested candidates could reduce time to correctly recognized meanings for previously untaught learners.
contrasts: Recognize an unfamiliar canonical Veka root for a message.
Recognize a matched-length, independently sourced international-root candidate for the same meaning.
risks: Related loanwords are not independent origins.
Cross-family attestation is not comprehension and longer forms may be slower.
proposals.decision_gate: Verify source provenance and sense, then preregister first-sight recognition, delayed recall, and speech-in-noise trials across language families; preserve core if no demonstrated net gain.

proposals.principle: Prefer invariant particles and clear independent expressions for ordinary conversation.
proposals.hypothesis: Small transparent constructions may simplify conversational repair without adding inflection.
contrasts: Ask for correction when the listener misunderstood the request.
risks: Overloading a particle can create ambiguity.
Structural brevity is not necessarily faster comprehension.
proposals.decision_gate: Independently review semantic equivalence, compare dialogue repair times and critical misunderstandings in counterbalanced recorded conversations.

proposals.principle: Offer optional distinctions between observation, inference and reported information.
proposals.hypothesis: Explicit source attribution may reduce consequential misunderstandings in teamwork.
contrasts: Someone reported the failure but I have not verified it.
I infer the failure from indirect evidence.
risks: Users may overstate certainty or misattribute provenance.
proposals.decision_gate: Test optional source phrases against unmarked alternatives with independently adjudicated understanding and no increase in serious errors.

proposals.principle: Allow explicit inclusive and exclusive first-person plural reference.
proposals.hypothesis: Optional listener-inclusion clarification could reduce coordination errors.
contrasts: We will attend and you are included.
We will attend and you are not included.
risks: Mandatory distinctions make ordinary utterances harder.
The listener might still be uncertain about the actual group.
proposals.decision_gate: Compare paraphrase accuracy and listener participation mistakes under matched contexts; default to explicit optional phrases rather than new compulsory pronouns.

proposals.principle: Make word derivation regular with explicit and stable argument-role semantics.
proposals.hypothesis: Predictable derived technical terms could reduce memorization without increasing semantic confusion.
contrasts: Describe the person who sends something.
risks: Regular morphology can still encode unclear relations.
Derivations may collide with canonical roots or silent compound boundaries.
proposals.decision_gate: Check reversible semantic roles, collisions, delayed acquisition and human interpretation before promoting any opt-in derivation.

proposals.principle: Distinguish the current discourse topic from newly contrasted information when necessary.
proposals.hypothesis: Optional information structure could reduce clarification turns in complex plans.
contrasts: Regarding the schedule, we changed only the meeting time.
Regarding the meeting time, we changed only the schedule.
proposals.decision_gate: Review scope and reference across turns then compare correct focus recovery per total communication minute.

proposals.principle: Study simple syllable shapes alongside sufficient phonetic and lexical contrast.
proposals.hypothesis: A sound profile optimized for clarity rather than minimum syllable inventory could reduce noisy-speech errors.
contrasts: Distinguish a numeric correction from the original number.
Distinguish a negated statement from its affirmative counterpart.
risks: Too few phonemes demand longer words.
Current near-pair counts are not recorded listener confusions.
proposals.decision_gate: Record independent human pronunciations and run blinded ABX and speech-in-noise tests before changing phonology.
